lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to shave his head and beard with a sword, divide the hair with scales, and burn a third.
Ezekiel is to slash a third with the sword, scatter a third to the wind, and throw a few strands into the well.
God says Jerusalem, set in the center of the nations, has rebelled more wickedly than they, so He is against her.
Because Jerusalem defiled His sanctuary, God will spare no one, and a third of her people will fall by famine outside her walls.
God will make Jerusalem a ruin and a horror to the nations, and He will send famine, wild beasts, plague and a sword.
